decisions.reason: The same message already records India as the target market and scope context; the keyword-selection rule does not otherwise change the audience requirement.
The same message already captures the required strong, direct, India-suitable hook; selecting reference-video keywords is owned by the separate wording requirement.
The source changes keyword selection but does not identify or alter any product benefit or claim.
The source does not change the content, placement, or style of the call to action.
Using keywords from the supplied references does not alter the existing reference basis or the requirement to produce an original, non-copying creative.
The statement about suitability for Indian users and reference keywords does not change actor nationality or gender preferences.
The script keyword revision does not change the freelancer's full-service production responsibility or supplied production elements.
The source criticizes the script concept and wording but does not change the required visual realism or UGC presentation.
The source does not change the number, duration, formats, or other packaging attributes of the test video.
The keyword and market-alignment decision has no effect on the audio-level requirement or its existing ambiguity.
